name: China Shengmu Organic Milk Limited
summary: China Shengmu Organic Milk Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of raw milk in the People's Republic of China. It offers raw milk for processing dairy products. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Bayannur, the People's Republic of China. As of August 3, 2026, China Shengmu Organic Milk Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Modern Dairy Holdings Ltd.
